title: Asɛmpatrɛw a Ɛwɔ Tete Kurow no Mu
intro: Tete kurow a mfutuma ayɛ hɔ ma, emu nkurɔfo agye ntini wɔ pow mu, ne kɔkɔbɔ a etwa to a wɔantie. Ɛnnɛ, fa wo nan si wɔn a Allah asoma wɔn sɛ wɔmfa nkrasɛm nkɔma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔn tirim yɛ den no dwumadie mu. Pow ho asɛm, gyidi nne biako pɛ, ne awiei a wɔde ahyɛde a ɛyɛ hu ahyɛ ano. Hena na ɔnam saa nsɛnkyerɛnnede yi so kasa?
clues: Allah na ɔsomaa yɛn kɔɔ kuro bi a ne nkurɔfoɔ atwe wɔn ho afiri nokorɛ ho
Yɛn mu baanu dii kan bae, afei nea ɔto so abiɛsa bɛkaa ho de hyɛɛ yɛn asɛmpatrɛw adwuma no mu den
Kurow no mufo pow yɛn, na wɔkae sɛ yɛnyɛ hwee sɛ nnipa te sɛ wɔn
Ɔkra biako pɛ a ofi kurow no awiei koraa tuu mmirika kɔka kyerɛɛ nkurɔfo no sɛ wonni yɛn akyi
Yɛsrɛɛ wɔn, nanso wɔpirim wɔn koma na wɔdan tiaa yɛn
Wɔ nteɛm a ɛyɛ hu biako a efi soro mu no, wɔmaa yɛn kurow no nyinaa yɛɛ komm

identity.answer: Kuro no mu Asomafoɔ a wɔwɔ Surah Ya-Sin mu

options: Kurow no mufo powee na wɔfrɛɛ wɔn atorofo
Wɔhyew no nkwa mu wɔ ogya kɛse bi a ɛredɛw mu
Mpataa kɛse bi menee no wɔ po a emu dɔ mu
Wɔhyɛɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛɛ adwumaden de si adum atenten
Wɔyɛɛ no ​​ayayade wɔ amena a ogya a ano yɛ den wom mu
trial.answer: Kurow no mufo powee na wɔfrɛɛ wɔn atorofo

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔnam nteɛm biako pɛ a ɛyɛ hu so sɛee kurow no (Sayha) .
Wɔmenee otirimɔdenfo no ne n’asraafo wɔ po a emu apaapae no mu
Wɔdanee nkurɔfo no bɛyɛɛ akraman ne bonsu
Abo a ɛtɔe fi soro sɛee kurow no
Nsuyiri a ano yɛ den prapraa mpɔtam hɔfo nyinaa kɔe
outcome.answer: Wɔnam nteɛm biako pɛ a ɛyɛ hu so sɛee kurow no (Sayha) .

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
